original.statement: The `s3.sse-encryption` configuration key is removed in Loki 3.0.0; use `sse.type` instead to configure SSE type, as AWS now defaults encryption of all buckets to SSE-S3.

corrected.statement: In Loki 3.0.0 the `s3.sse-encryption` option is removed. Environments whose Loki workloads still pass the `s3.sse-encryption` flag are exposed and should use `sse.type` to set the SSE type.

decision.reason: [ev-c8a8a9c16d41] names `s3.sse-encryption`, a dotted Loki option name. In the same section, names in this style are explicitly CLI flags ([ev-3cb906d8d02b], [ev-f5a61f629314], [ev-f15092605ae3]). Nothing in the evidence presents it as a Helm chart values path, so values-key{s3.sse-encryption} reads the wrong configuration source. The exposure is a workload that still sets this flag. The evidence does not name the matching YAML key, so the condition cannot cover it.
